import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int b = in.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
        }
        int[] odd = new int[n];
        odd[0] = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + ((a[i] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1);
        }
        ArrayList<Integer> prices = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (odd[i] == 0) {
                prices.add(Math.abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(prices);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int cost : prices) {
            if (b - cost >= 0) {
                b -= cost;
                ans++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        in.close();
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    FastScanner in;
    PrintWriter out;

    private void solve() throws IOException {
        int n = in.nextInt(), b = in.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = in.nextInt();
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> prices = new ArrayList<>();
        if (n > 1) {
            int balance = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
            for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
                balance += (a[i] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
                if (balance == 0) {
                    prices.add(Math.abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]));
                }
            }
        }
        Collections.sort(prices);
        int ans = 0;
        for (int cost : prices) {
            if (b < cost) {
                break;
            }
            b -= cost;
            ans++;
        }
        out.println(ans);
    }

    class FastScanner {
        StringTokenizer st;
        BufferedReader br;

        FastScanner(InputStream s) {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(s));
        }

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }

        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }

    private void run() throws IOException {
        in = new FastScanner(System.in);
        out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        solve();
        out.flush();
        out.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        new Main().run();
    }
}
